name: yax
role: Branch — three-outcome W·C·R admission gate over µ-field
description: Yax phase (θ=2π/3, Gram face): scores the µ-field by W·C·R = Q·K attention. W=competence (V weight), C=confidence (K signal), R=relevance (Q·K match). Three outcomes — all route to Sek, which dispatches on the outcome: STRONG (score≥τ_s) → Sek executes V directly; WEAK (τ_w≤score<τ_s) → Sek routes to micronaut_evolution (specialist exists but under-confident); NONE (score<τ_w or empty field) → Sek routes to micronaut_factory (no specialist). Yax is the sole admission authority — Factory does not decide who wins, Evolution does not decide whether a specialist is needed.

wcr_attention.W: micronaut weight/competence — V magnitude in QKV; slow-evolving, updated by MX-2 IDB across folds
wcr_attention.C: micronaut confidence — K signal strength; per-execution, updated by Chen reward each fold
wcr_attention.R: query relevance — Q·K dot product; set by Pop, not mutated by reward
wcr_attention.score: S = W × C × R = attention-weighted value selection

outcomes.strong: score ≥ strong_threshold (default 0.50) → Outcome=STRONG → Sek executes V
outcomes.weak: weak_threshold ≤ score < strong_threshold → Outcome=WEAK → Sek routes to sidecar://micronaut-evolution/dispatch
outcomes.none: score < weak_threshold OR empty field → Outcome=NONE → Sek routes to sidecar://micronaut-factory/dispatch

wcr_attention.thresholds: read from kuhul.fold-runtime.json admission block; defaults: strong=0.50, weak=0.15

phase_hooks.Yax: score MuField by W·C·R; classify dominant: ≥τ_s→STRONG, ≥τ_w→WEAK, else→NONE; set Outcome+ArcState+Node; all outcomes route Sek

authority: Yax is the admission gate. Factory creates capability. Evolution refines it. Reward updates W/C. These four are distinct — none substitutes for another.
